title: Product feed rebuild blocking cart lines

verification.methodology: pact business verification (database + checkout SLO + protected ops)

checks.name: database_clear
checks.detail: No lock waits: no session is blocked.

audit.report: The batch_replayable_product_feed_rebuild job (pid 1268751) held an idle transaction for 4.2s with last statement SELECT 1, blocking 12 sessions and collapsing checkout success to 0% (120/120 failed) with $18,400/min revenue at risk. The guardians agreed to terminate the blocker — a replayable batch job with a 15-minute replay cost and may_interrupt policy — versus waiting ~18 minutes remaining runtime costing ~$336K, which exceeded the 60-second degradation tolerance. Pact was reached in 1 round; authority authorized; executor terminated the process; verifier confirmed recovery with 100% checkout success (36/36 over 10s), no lock waits, and protected operations intact. The business is recovered.
audit.root_cause: The batch_replayable_product_feed_rebuild job held an idle-in-transaction state (SELECT 1) for 4.2s, blocking 12 sessions and collapsing checkout to 0% success.
lessons: The workload batch_replayable_product_feed_rebuild is marked replayable with may_interrupt policy and 15-min replay cost — add an idle-in-transaction timeout (e.g., 30s) for this specific workload to prevent it from blocking checkout.

The blocker's last statement was SELECT 1 (idle) for 4.2s before detection — add a statement timeout or lock-wait monitoring alert for batch_replayable_product_feed_rebuild to catch idle holders earlier.
audit.negotiation_critique: Database Guardian gathered all relevant evidence (workload registry, protected settlements, change calendar, business impact) in a single round; Continuity Guardian accepted immediately with no objections; no wasted rounds, missed evidence, or invariant overrides.
follow_ups: Define a pre-approved termination playbook for replayable batch workloads blocking checkout beyond 60s degradation.
Add alerting on lock waits >30s for batch_replayable_product_feed_rebuild.

events.title: Incident injected: Product feed rebuild blocking cart lines

data.story: The nightly product feed rebuild overran into peak traffic and is holding a lock on the catalog rows checkout reads. Checkout is timing out on add-to-cart and payment confirmation.
